evidence: Agent-visible text is instruction.md plus /instructions/*.md and /assets/seed_data.json (environment/Dockerfile:14-15 copies only instructions/ and assets/). A scripted scan (python -B -I) of those files for the skill's pattern judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel, extended with functional|polish|visual|gate|verifier|grader|grading|likert|probe|mcp|logs, returned zero hits. None of the 61 JUDGE-* sentinels (e.g. JUDGE-CS0, JUDGE-W0..W3, JUDGE-L1, JUDGE-M1/M2 in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:47-79) appear in visible files, and none of the 28 criterion ids appear verbatim; only natural English coincidences ('Search and transcripts' heading in walls-and-retention.md:31, 'Enter sends' and 'Escape closes' in conversations.md:29) match id words with spaces, which are product statements, not ids. Longest verbatim n-gram overlap with criteria/prompts/app_context is the seeded account table and seed message bodies (12-gram), plus short natural requirement phrases at 8 words ('a link that opens in a new tab', 'shows a short preview of the linked message'), which is criteria quoting the public requirement, not the brief reproducing rubric text. The brief never mentions dimensions, weights, gates, test paths, the judge model or Playwright; its 'try it in a browser' line (instruction.md:9) is ordinary product advice. Weak/alternative app consideration: since no probe literal or criterion wording is disclosed, a model cannot pre-seed sentinel strings or tailor to named criteria; a conforming app is not penalised by anything in the brief. Static row; no runtime evidence required.
